summary: Fill the region between two parallel diagonal lines with red, connecting endpoints of the right diagonal to their left diagonal projection points
src: both endpoints s of the right diagonal line
dst: left diagonal projection point d (or midpoint between two points) on the other parallel line
trajectory: fill red inside the area bounded by the right diagonal line and the left projection path (continuous red region), keep the source pixels
notes: The key challenge is identifying two parallel diagonal lines and filling the parallelogram-like region between them with red while preserving the original colored diagonal pixels
